description: All your subscription revenue under one roof — Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, RevenueCat.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run css

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: 32 random bytes, base64. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. **Back it up:** if it's lost, every stored provider key becomes unreadable. Never rotate it in place.

ALLOW_SIGNUP.description: Leave `true` until you've created your own account, then set it to `false` so nobody else can sign up on your instance.
